questions.question: At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2024/25 season?
Who holds the record for 'Best Bowling Average' in the 06/07 season (List A)?
How many runs separate the all-time #1 (Tazmin Brits) and #2 (Yolandi Potgieter) run-scorers (List A) in the 18/19 season?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits: 542 — Yolandi Potgieter: 445 — a gap of 97.

questions.question: Who topped the wickets charts in the 25/26 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Nosipho Vezi led with 15 wickets, a joint record shared with Nthabiseng Nini.

questions.question: At which ground did Hester van Heerden record their career-best bowling figures (3-46, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval, against Knights on 2013/01/12.
